mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60%+ of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive Fed tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline YoY or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals economic weakness that depresses corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days during labor market stress regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply chain activity that supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day forward returns is below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window or INDPRO shows positive correlation with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1400.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer spending momentum and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when HOUST < 1400.0 or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% signal aggressive monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%) indicates economic maturity where policy pivots become likely, reducing equity upside potential and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60%+ of periods when GDPC1 annual growth exceeds 2.5% or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
